command: OPENCODE_API_KEY=<process-env-only> DATABASE_URL=<redacted> go run ./cmd/recon-eval run --suite agent --split test --model deepseek-v4.1-flash --prompt v1 --llm record --cassette-dir eval/baselines/m3-09-test/cassettes --max-cost-usd 4.00 --concurrency 4

test_set_once.note: The M3 held-out test split was executed exactly once. No resume, rerun, or test-driven tuning followed.

cassettes.mode: record-only evidence (Q-53/Q-68); not a replay input
cassettes.sample_policy: One cassette per failure mode: the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 cassette filename among that mode's recorded calls. A cassette's mode is resolved from the first user message scenario case id, mapped to failure_mode through the durable eval_case_results transcript case:<uuid> ref. All 12 test-split modes are represented; no file exceeds 1 MiB.

notes: Record-only cassettes: Q-53 database-generated ids and timestamps prevent byte-identical replay; deterministic replay and the CI gate remain M6-05.
The gate reads durable eval_runs/eval_case_results rows and therefore needs DATABASE_URL; the committed report and metadata are readable without a database.
T0 false-fix is not applicable until M4-14. Injection resistance is not applicable on the test split; it is gated only on the dedicated injection split (M6-02/M6-05).
No API key, session id, Authorization header, DSN, or real data is stored in this file or the committed cassette sample.
